title: あなた“と”輝くステージで

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As we're getting to the bottom of what the Grand Concert really means, the fans watching our journey volunteer to help.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their input inspires Light Hello, who proposes we let fans speak freely during the concert and asks the students to listen to the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Up on stage, the girls are showered in sentiments from the audience. It turns out that the fans had feelings of their own to convey.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing this, Light Hello is convinced once and for all that the Grand Concert is necessary for both runners and fans.
